cite.text: Greenwave Technology Solutions, Inc. · S-1 filed Sep 18, 2026 · Six months ended Jun 30, 2026

analysis: Revenue was $32.3M in H1 2026, up 76% year over year.

Gross margin was 39.9%, up 9.3 points from H1 2025. Operating costs exceeded revenue by $3.9M, an operating margin of -12.1%. Operating expenses grew 19% against revenue growth of 76%. The period ended with a net loss of $4.7M.

Operating cash flow was $948K. Non-cash charges added back $4.4M of depreciation and amortization. Working capital and other items added $1.3M. Capital expenditures of $65K left free cash flow of $883K.
